# Partner due-diligence checklist (blank form)

Complete one per candidate partner **before** any Drop is announced. A "No" or "Unknown" on a required item means the partner is not approved until trustees minute a reason and a mitigation. This form does not name any real partner. Not legal advice; trustees should compare it with current Charity Commission guidance on due diligence and monitoring end use of funds, which I have not re-read in this session.

**Partner:** [NAME] · **Country/region:** [ ] · **Assessor:** [ ] · **Date:** [ ] · **Reviewed by trustee:** [ ] · **Decision:** [Approved / Declined / Conditions]

## A. Identity and legal status (required)
| # | Check | Evidence | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | Legal name, registration number and registering authority | Register extract (date accessed) | |
| A2 | Registered and active; accounts or reports filed | | |
| A3 | Governing body / officers identified; none appear on sanctions or terrorism lists | Screening record (date, lists used) | |
| A4 | Beneficial ownership / control understood | | |
| A5 | Bank account in the organisation's own name, in the country of operation or a standard correspondent route | Bank letter (held privately) | |

## B. Track record (required)
| # | Check | Evidence | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| B1 | Delivered comparable work before (what, where, when, volumes) | Reports, third-party references | |
| B2 | At least [2] independent references contacted | Reference notes | |
| B3 | Public presence consistent with claims (site, social, press) | Links | |
| B4 | Adverse media and complaints search | Search record | |
| B5 | Relationship to any RallyGood trustee or volunteer declared | Conflict-of-interest declaration | |

## C. Capacity and controls (required)
| # | Check | Evidence | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | Local procurement process, price comparison and receipts | Sample documents | |
| C2 | Beneficiary selection method that is fair and recorded | Policy or description | |
| C3 | Distribution method, supervision and access constraints | | |
| C4 | Can provide receipts, delivery sign-off and (where safe and consented) photos | Agreed evidence list | |
| C5 | Financial controls: segregation of duties, record-keeping | Policy or interview note | |
| C6 | Handles cash/transfers lawfully; no unmanaged cash to intermediaries | | |

## D. Safeguarding and protection (required)
| # | Check | Evidence | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| D1 | Written safeguarding policy; named lead; reporting route | Policy | |
| D2 | Staff/volunteer vetting appropriate to the work | | |
| D3 | Photo and data consent practice; will follow RallyGood's photo rules | Signed agreement | |
| D4 | Incident reporting to RallyGood within agreed time | Agreement clause | |

## E. Risk and legal (required)
| # | Check | Evidence | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| E1 | Sanctions and export/payment restrictions checked for the country, route and goods | Record, date, who | |
| E2 | Counter-terrorism / diversion risk assessed, esp. in conflict-affected areas | Risk note | |
| E3 | Security situation and access; contingency if delivery is blocked | | |
| E4 | Local law on foreign funding / NGO registration checked | | |
| E5 | Data protection for any beneficiary data shared | | |

## F. Agreement (required before funds move)
- [ ] Written agreement with scope, budget, evidence, reporting dates, audit/visit right, return of unspent funds, termination, safeguarding and anti-fraud clauses
- [ ] Payment in tranches linked to evidence (suggested: [x]% on signing, [y]% on purchase evidence, balance on delivery sign-off) **[trustees to set]**
- [ ] Single named contact each side and an escalation route
- [ ] Conflict-of-interest declarations on file

## G. Decision record
Risk rating: [Low / Medium / High] · Conditions: [ ] · Max exposure per Drop: £[ ] · Re-review date: [ ] · Trustee minute reference: [ ]

**Red flags that stop the process:** pressure to pay quickly or in cash; bank account not in the organisation's name; refusal to provide receipts; vague or inconsistent figures; photos reused from elsewhere; unwillingness to be named; unexplained intermediaries.
